concept_interpretation: Retained ImageGen three-view sheet inspected again during r003 repair: quiet beige inflated shell, shallow umbilical seam and pale rounded rim. The concept has no sharply bounded radial cutaway. Use a uniform main-shell base color for this repair; retain existing pale rim and geometry. No new texture or anatomy claims.
hidden_surfaces: Rear carries compatible shallow dimple and winding seam; fully closed rounded edge and fossilized terminal region. No soft tissues, exposed chambers, or asserted original pigmentation.
